result.summary: This pull request ensures that CCoinsViewDB iterators and compaction hold a shared lock on a new database mutex, preventing ResizeCache from resetting m_db while iterators remain active. It also extends the synchronization framework with SharedMutex, SharedLock, and READ_LOCK primitives that hook into DEBUG_LOCKORDER and support non-LIFO lock releases.
result.problem: RPCs such as gettxoutsetinfo, scantxoutset, and dumptxoutset keep LevelDB iterators open after releasing cs_main. If AssumeUTXO cache rebalancing calls ResizeCache concurrently, the underlying database wrapper is reset while an iterator is still live, causing LevelDB to abort.

result.card: This PR prevents LevelDB aborts by holding a shared lock on coins DB cursors and compaction so that ResizeCache waits for active iterations to finish before resetting the database wrapper. In doing so, it introduces SharedMutex, SharedLock, and READ_LOCK to the synchronization utilities with full DEBUG_LOCKORDER tracking and non-LIFO lock popping. It resolves a crash hazard reported during review of cache compaction and AssumeUTXO rebalancing. The approach was shaped collaboratively with andrewtoth and has a Concept ACK from sedited.
